value.rationale: The natural closing seam for a linear composition introduces a nonlocal boundary observable. Its covariance with all internal adjacent differences undergoes a sharp transition at total size 15 and converges to a surprising negative constant. This boundary-bulk reversal is not a routine exercise in the marginal variation formulas.
